UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content:
/* Apache II 评分 REST API — M/ObjectScript 原生实现 ===================================================== Web Application 配置： 管理门户 → System Administration → Security → Applications → Web Applications 新建 /api/apache2 → Dispatch Class: ApacheII.API.Handler → 启用 REST + CORS
接口： POST /api/apache2/save — 保存评估记录（含患者信息） GET /api/apache2/records — 查询所有记录 GET /api/apache2/trend — 查询患者近30天死亡率趋势（按天去重取最新） GET /api/apache2/health — 健康检查 */

XData.name: UrlMap
XData.Data: <Routes> <Route Url="/save" Method="POST" Call="SaveAssessment" Cors="true" /> <Route Url="/records" Method="GET" Call="ListRecords" Cors="true" /> <Route Url="/trend" Method="GET" Call="TrendData" Cors="true" /> <Route Url="/health" Method="GET" Call="HealthCheck" Cors="true" /> <Route Url="/export" Method="GET" Call="ExportCSV" Cors="true" /> </Routes>

Method.name: HealthCheck
Method.Implementation: Set %response.ContentType = "application/json; charset=UTF-8" Set %response.CharSet = "UTF-8" Set obj = { "status": "ok", "iris_version": ($zv), "namespace": ($namespace), "time": ($zdatetime($ztimestamp,3,1,3)) } Write obj.%ToJSON() Quit $$$OK

Method.name: SaveAssessment
ListRecords

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: // ===== 查询近30天死亡率趋势（按天去重取最新） =====

Method.name: TrendData
OnPreHTTP
Method.Implementation: If $get(%request.CgiEnvs("REQUEST_METHOD")) = "OPTIONS" { Set %response.Status = 200 Do %response.SetHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*") Do %response.SetHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS") Do %response.SetHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type") Quit 0 } Quit 1

Method.name: ExportCSV
